# Image to PDF — Voiceover Script

Target: ~2:10, internal demo
Format: Screen recording + AI voiceover (CapCut/剪映)

---

## Voiceover (with timestamps matching recording)

### 0:00 — Intro
"Hey everyone. This is a fully interactive prototype of PDF Tools, built entirely through conversation with Kiro — no manual coding involved. This demo video was also generated by Kiro, and the AI voiceover is powered by Quick Suite. Let me walk you through it."

### 0:06 — PDF Tools Home
"Starting from the local homepage, we find the PDF Tools entry point from the local tiles. The top section gives quick access to all eight tools. Below that, users see their PDF files — scrollable and searchable."

### 0:17 — Search & Preview
"Let's try the search. Typing Invoice filters the list instantly. Tapping a result opens the built-in PDF viewer."

### 0:27 — Encrypted File
"Back on the home page, we can also open password-protected files. Enter the password, and it opens right up."

### 0:38 — Image Picker
"Now let's try Image to PDF. A first-time guide shows users they can swipe to multi-select. We switch to the Camera folder and pick a few photos."

### 0:52 — Preview & Remove
"There's a full-screen preview — tap the expand icon to check any image. And we can remove a selection from the strip at the bottom."

### 1:02 — Confirm & Enter Editor
"After confirming, users choose their import options. Then we land in the editor."

### 1:08 — Rotate & Crop
"The bottom toolbar has all the tools. Rotate flips the image. Crop lets users drag the corners to trim."

### 1:18 — Filter
"Filters enhance the image — Color Plus boosts saturation and contrast. Filters are per-image, so each page can have its own look."

### 1:28 — Delete
"Navigating to the last page, we can delete it with a tap and confirm."

### 1:35 — Reorder
"Reorder lets users drag pages into a different order."

### 1:43 — Add
"Need more pages? Tap Add to bring in images from the album or camera."

### 1:53 — Page Size
"Page Size gives options like Fit, A4, Letter, and Legal — each in portrait or landscape."

### 2:00 — Preview
"Tapping Done takes us to the preview page. Users can scroll through all pages for a final check."

### 2:08 — Convert & Open
"They name the file, tap Convert, and the PDF is generated on-device. From the result page, they can share or open the PDF directly."

### 2:16 — Outro
"All the other tools in the prototype are fully functional as well — Scan, ID Card, Compress, Merge, Extract, and more. Feel free to try them out. Thanks for watching!"

---

## Tips for CapCut
- Paste each section as a separate text-to-speech clip
- Align the start of each clip to the timestamp above
- Use a natural English voice
- If a section runs long, trim the pause at the end
- Total video is about 2:18
